notes: Modified cash basis; governmental fund balances = cash (no liabilities), roll-forward from p5 Total column. Taxes 357,939 split using General Fund schedule p15 and LB 840 Fund p21 (ties to Statement of Activities p2); Intergovernmental 129,632 split using the General Fund intergovernmental breakdown p15 (homestead, tax credits, pro-rate out of state aid). Business-type from the modified cash basis proprietary statement p9-10 (matches government-wide net position); the accrual-basis proprietary statements and accrual department schedule (p23-26, net position 2,683,978) are supplementary and not used. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (includes capital assets and notes/bonds). Detail: General, Lottery, Economic Development (by program), LB 840 and Municipal Utilities (by department, modified cash p22) fund schedules; the combined all-funds budget schedule (p13-14) is superseded by these; its Nursing Home Bonds (16,420) and Airport (13,421) expenditures belong to funds not in the governmental fund statements and are not recorded.
